data.title: PayPal Micro-Transfer Execution and Monitoring
data.mission_parameters: {"BATCH_PROCESSING":["PROCESS transfers in 6 batches of 5 transfers each","ALLOW 2 minutes between batches for PayPal processing","IMPLEMENT success verification after each batch","AUTOMATICALLY retry failed transfers in next batch","LOG all transfer attempts and results"],"REALTIME_MONITORING":["MONITOR PayPal event logs for \"learnworlds\" app","TRACK each transfer status every 15 seconds","SEND immediate notifications for completed transfers","ALERT on any failed or pending transfers","PROVIDE running total of successfully transferred funds"]}
